Job Title: Chief Accountant R2R

Reports to: Process Delivery Manager R2R

Role Type: Team Manager/Individual contributor

Location: Chinchwad, Pune

Job Roles & Responsibilities:

Responsible for managing and ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely financial reporting for one or more legal entities within the sub-region. The role supports statutory, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements while partnering closely with the CFO, Company Finance Manager, auditors, and key business stakeholders to deliver high-quality financial reporting and control.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & Close Management

- Coordinate and oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities for assigned legal entities.

- Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting in compliance with IFRS, Ind AS, local GAAP, Companies Act requirements, and Group accounting policies.

- Review journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial statements to ensure completeness and accuracy.

- Support consolidation and reporting requirements for group and management reporting.

Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

- Prepare and coordinate statutory financial statements in collaboration with the Company Finance Manager.

- Ensure compliance with Companies Act, SEBI regulations, stock exchange reporting requirements, and other applicable statutory regulations.

- Coordinate filing requirements, disclosures, and regulatory submissions related to listed entity obligations.

- Monitor changes in accounting standards and regulatory requirements and drive implementation as required.

Governance, Controls & Audit

- Ensure compliance with corporate governance requirements and internal control frameworks, including IFC/SOX (where applicable).

- Coordinate internal, statutory, tax, and regulatory audits and serve as the key finance contact for auditors.

- Drive timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions.

- Support risk assessment and control monitoring activities across the reporting process.

Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management

- Act as the primary finance interface for the Company Finance Manager, CFO, Corporate Finance, and external stakeholders.

- Partner with business teams to provide financial insights, accounting guidance, and reporting support.

- Support Board, Audit Committee, and leadership reporting requirements through preparation of high-quality financial analyses and presentations.

Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement

- Support CFO and senior management with profitability analysis, margin reviews, working capital reporting, and quarterly board packs.

- Drive process standardization, automation, and reporting improvements through SKF Business Excellence and digital initiatives.

- Lead initiatives focused on improving reporting quality, compliance, efficiency, and control effectiveness.

- Actively contribute to finance transformation projects, ERP enhancements, and process optimization initiatives.

Experience

- Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA).

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Finance, Accounting, and Controllership functions.

- Demonstrated experience within:

- Financial Accounting & Reporting

- Financial Controlling

- Statutory Compliance

- Audit Management

- Corporate Governance

- Listed Company Reporting Environment

Competency Profile

- Solid experience in a listed company environment.

- In-depth knowledge of Ind AS, IFRS, Companies Act, and regulatory reporting requirements.

- Strong understanding of financial close, consolidation, and statutory reporting processes.

- Experience managing internal and external audits.

- Knowledge of Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and governance frameworks.

- Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and business partnering skills.

- Proven ability to identify and implement process improvements.

- Advanced ERP knowledge (SAP/S4HANA preferred).

- Strong communication, presentation, and board-reporting capabilities.

Role Success Criteria

- Timely and accurate financial, statutory, and regulatory reporting.

- Zero material audit findings and strong compliance adherence.

- Effective stakeholder engagement with CFO, auditors, and business leadership.

- Continuous improvement in reporting quality, controls, and automation.

- Demonstrates ownership, accountability, collaboration, and a strong team-first mindset.

- Supports the organization in maintaining high standards of governance expected of a listed entity.

Job Title: Commercial FP&A Analyst Coatings

Location: Pune, India

Shift: Night Shift

Experience: 5 - 10 years

Role Purpose

The Commercial FP&A Analyst will support the Commercial Finance function by providing financial analysis and business insights across P&L, budgeting, forecasting, margin management, OPEX, CAPEX and working capital. The role involves partnering with Commercial Navigators, Sales teams and Global FP&A stakeholders to analyse financial performance, identify trends, explain variances and support business decision-making. The candidate will also drive reporting automation, process standardisation and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and manage P&L, Working Capital, Commercial CAPEX and Balance Sheet provisions, including budgeting, rolling forecasts, month-end closing and financial analysis.

• Partner with business stakeholders to prepare budgets, forecasts, management reports and presentations.

• Support month-end closing activities, including accrual reviews, one-off items, flash P&L commentary and closing presentations.

• Conduct margin and profitability analysis at customer, product and country levels, including Price-Volume-Mix (PVM) analysis.

• Analyse COGS, OPEX, Sales and Distribution expenses, CAPEX and working capital to identify variances and improvement opportunities.

• Collaborate with Commercial Navigators, Sales teams, Global BU FP&A and Finance teams to provide insights and recommendations.

• Prepare standard and ad hoc financial reports, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.

• Drive reporting automation, process standardisation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Requirements

• CA / ICWA (maximum 3 attempts) or MBA from a Top 20 B-school.

• 5 - 10 years of experience in FP&A, Commercial Finance or Financial Analysis.

• Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, P&L management and financial reporting.

• Good understanding of margin analysis, profitability, Price-Volume-Mix (PVM), COGS, OPEX, CAPEX and working capital.

• Experience in month-end closing, variance analysis and management reporting.

• Strong knowledge of HFM, ERP systems (preferably SAP) and Business Intelligence tools.

• Advanced Excel skills and experience in financial modelling and report automation.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to interpret complex financial data and present meaningful business insights.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Shift Requirement

• This position is based in Pune and requires working in a night shift.

• Candidates must be comfortable coordinating with global Finance and business stakeholders across different time zones.

• Ability to independently manage deliverables and ensure accurate and timely reporting during night-shift operations is essential.

Position Summary
The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Manager is responsible for leading the Company’s budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and business analysis activities. This role serves as a strategic business partner to executive leadership and operational stakeholders by delivering timely financial insights, supporting critical business decisions, and driving financial performance across the organization.
The FP&A Manager will develop financial plans, enhance reporting capabilities, and support the Company’s long-term strategic objectives. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong analytical judgment, commercial acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
Financial Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting
• Lead the annual budgeting process, monthly/quarterly rolling forecasts, and long-range financial planning initiatives.

• Develop, maintain, and enhance financial models supporting revenue, operating expenses, headcount, capital expenditures, cash flow, and profitability projections.

• Monitor financial performance against last year, budget and forecast, identifying key trends, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.

• Conduct scenario planning and sensitivity analyses to support strategic decision-making and resource allocation.

• Coordinate planning activities across business functions to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and planning assumptions.

Financial Reporting and Analysis
• Prepare and distribute monthly, quarterly, and annual management reporting packages.

• Analyze financial and operational results and provide clear explanations of key business drivers and variances.

• Develop, monitor, and continuously improve key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.

• Present financial results, outlooks, and recommendations to executive and senior leadership.

• Business Partnership and Strategic Support

• Partner with departmental leaders to evaluate business initiatives, investments, and operating strategies.

• Provide decision support related to hiring plans, capital investments, pricing, and expense management.

• Perform profitability, margin, customer, product, and cost analyses to improve financial performance.

Process Improvement and Financial Systems
• Identify and implement improvements to budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analytical processes.

• Drive automation and standardization initiatives that enhance efficiency, scalability, and data integrity.

• Collaborate with Accounting, IT, and operational teams to improve financial data quality and reporting capabilities.

• Maintain clear documentation of planning processes, methodologies, assumptions, and relevant controls.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner closely with Accounting to ensure consistency between actual results, forecasts, and financial reporting.

• Support month-end and quarter-end review processes through variance analysis and management reporting.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders by translating financial data into actionable recommendations.

• Lead or participate in special projects and ad hoc financial analyses requested by senior management

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field required.

• MBA, CA, CMA, or other relevant professional certification preferred.

• Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, consulting, or a related field.

• Demonstrated experience managing budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and management reporting processes.

• Experience partnering with business leaders and presenting financial information to senior management.

• Prior experience in SaaS, technology, fintech, financial services, or another high-growth environment preferred.

Technical Competencies

Company Description Long Shot Assignments is a digital platform that connects CA firms, individuals, small businesses, and corporates with service professionals for short-term professional assignments across India. Since inception, the platform has built a network of over 20,000 freelancers across more than 1,000 cities in 29 states and union territories, and continues to expand into new locations. By using Long Shot’s app or web platform, clients can post their assignment requirements and leverage a match-making algorithm that identifies suitable professionals based on proximity, skills, and availability. Professionals can register as freelancers, receive daily assignment notifications through the Long Shot Assignments app, and access current and prospective opportunities in their preferred locations. This network-driven model offers flexible, project-based work and exposure to diverse clients and industries.
Role Description This is a contract, on-site role for a Chartered Accountant specialized in SAP FICO, based in Mumbai. The professional will be responsible for configuring and maintaining SAP FICO modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, and Controlling, in line with client requirements. Day-to-day tasks include performing financial accounting and reporting, supporting monthly and yearly closing activities, and ensuring accurate integration of finance data across SAP modules. • Proficiency in MS Excel and common business tools for data analysis, reconciliations, and financial modeling.
• Ability to work on-site with client teams in Mumbai, manage multiple assignments, and deliver within agreed deadlines.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills with attention to accuracy and regulatory standards.
• Clear, professional communication skills for interacting with finance, operations, and IT stakeholders.
• Prior experience in consulting, audit, or ERP implementation environments is an advantage.

data.job_description:
About the job:

- Financial Reporting & Month-End closing: Oversee general ledger activities, month/year-end closures, control/scrutiny of trial balance line items, preparation of accurate financial statements as per IND AS.

- Domestic Trade Receivables Control: Monitor accounts receivable in SAP S4 Hana, Check Sales invoice & receipt knocking, Prepare in excel sales invoice wise aging reports & circulating to relevant stake holder, sending dunning letters, Monitor ECL provision etc, Monitor credit limits & credit periods through SAP S4 HANA & ensure compliance.

- Export Receivables Control: Domestic Receivables + interacting with banks to ensure that EDPMS records are up to date as per FEMA. Filing export exchange control documents with bank.

- Domestic Trade Payable Control: Monitor accounts payable in SAP S4 Hana, Check vendor invoice & payment knocking, Prepare in excel purchase invoice wise aging reports & circulating to relevant stake holder.

- Import Payable Control: Domestic Payables + interacting with banks to ensure that IDPMS records are up to date as per FEMA. Filing import exchange control documents with bank.

- Inventory Control: Monitor inventory Aging, Circulate inventory aging report to relevant stake holder, Participate in inventory verification exercise.

- Fixed Assets Register: Oversee/Checking of fixed assets register, capitalization of assets, depreciation working.

- Control Accounts in SAP S4 HANA: Ensure that sum of all individual supplier/customer balances in the subsidiary payables ledgers perfectly match the control account balance.

- Statutory & Tax Compliance: Manage corporate taxation (e.g., GST, TDS, Income Tax) and ensure all regulatory filings are precise and strictly on time.

- Audits & Internal Controls: Coordinate both internal and external audits. Maintain rigorous internal controls to safeguard company assets.

- Team Leadership: Mentor, lead, and train the accounting team, fostering a high-performance work environment.

We are looking for an individual to join the Client Experience (Product Support) team supporting Investment Accounting Manager (formerly InvestOne). The team provides production support to global IAM clients across a suite of products, with InvestOne at the core. 

What you will be doing 

Principal responsibilities 

• Provide day-to-day support to clients across multiple FIS products. 

• Ensure client queries are resolved with high-quality, timely responses. 

• Act as the first escalation point for clients and liaise with Level 3 support teams to ensure issues are prioritized and resolved. 

• Work closely with internal teams, including Product Development, Technology Services Management, Professional Services, and other relevant groups. 

• Understand client configurations and workflow processes, recreate client scenarios, and report issues to the appropriate teams. 

• Document customer information and recurring technical issues to support product-quality programs and product development. 

• Recreate client issues in test environments and identify and document how applications and systems interact to support business processes. 

• Contribute to ad hoc projects and initiatives based on business needs. 

• Maintain client satisfaction through regular follow-ups, feedback gathering, expectation management, and clear, efficient communication. 

• Work in rotational APAC shifts. 

What you bring 

Knowledge and experience 

• Minimum 7-9 years of Capital Markets experience, with a focus on fund accounting. 

• NAV calculation experience with mutual funds or hedge funds. 

• Essential knowledge of financial instruments and fund accounting. 

• Excellent oral and written communication skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Competencies

Sourcing Model 

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.
